row.body: my weathered bundle entry says the crop trial workers brushed off rust-colored grit. the chickens stopped moving before the back road closed.
row.title: weathered bundle note — late wednesday

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the rust-colored grit while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
